description:
Optional ImageIO reader backed by ImageMagick 7 (MagickWand API) via
        Project Panama. Adds cross-platform support for 200+ image formats
        including EPS, PSD, XCF, DPX, TGA, and more. Requires ImageMagick 7
        installed on the system. Not included in the imageio-native aggregator —
        add this dependency explicitly to opt in.
